text:
tara: Lunch idea — setting up a 'Model Autograph Line' next Friday in the kitchen. Bring a 1-line prompt and the model will "sign" it with its best one-liner. :sparkles:
benjamin: Love this. Do we assign models like bands? 'GPT-4 Turbo' is headliner, 'mistral' is indie opener? :guitar: :laughing:
linh: Can we have rules: no temperature > 1.2, no giving the model your actual sandwich. :sandwich:
sara: Also should we decide whether signatures are deterministic? i.e., same prompt => same signature. Otherwise chaos. :joy:
tara: We'll have two queues: deterministic (temp 0) and freestyle (temp 0.9). People can file a 'replay' request if they want identical autographs later.
benjamin: I call 'Write my repo commit as a haiku' for deterministic lane.
linh: I'll bring index cards. Maybe we tape them to the fridge with the prompt and the autograph output.
sara: Ops-bot — can you reserve the table and post a reminder?
ops-bot: Reminder set for next Friday 12:00-13:00 in Kitchen A. Event: Model Autograph Line. RSVP with :wave:.
tara: Example prompt we'll put on a card (feel free to riff):
```
Prompt: "Sign this like a tired senior engineer who just found a missing semicolon."
Signature: (model output here)
```
benjamin: I'm imagining the signatures will vary by decoding strategy: greedy = curt, beam = diplomatic, top-p = poetic chaos.
linh: Propose a "celebrity tier" board: Sticker for models that produce the best dad jokes. :sticker:
sara: Can we have a 'politely decline' lane for models that hit safety? "Sorry, can't sign that." :sweat_smile:
tara: Love all of this. I'll drop a table sign-up and a sticky-note kit. If anyone has a ridiculous prompt idea drop it here and I'll sneak it into the freestyle deck.
benjamin: Prompt idea: "Sign this as if you're a coffee machine writing a motivational post-it."
linh: Ooh also: 'Model does its signature in emoji only' challenge. Winner gets a leftover donut. :doughnut:
sara: Tagging @design to see if they want to make a tiny 'autograph line' poster.
tara: OK poster request sent. We'll keep it low-key and friendly. See y'all Friday. :wave:
